sourceMode: standalone local file:// HTML in installed Chromium
fixtureDisclosure: A Human save is created through the intro. Hall/Barracks 3, Warehouse 10, Bootcamp 1 and capped prerequisite resources are seeded to skip construction/research. The recruit control queues real Archers and spends real resources; the actual engine tick is advanced by the queue's remaining duration so the real completion path delivers the stack. Formation, map click, March, NPC battle, sprite draw and v07 Save/Reload use the actual application. Enemy flip is checked separately with an isolated cloned renderer snapshot; it is not represented as gameplay.
